verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Grafana Alerting (threshold-based rules), SLOs, and AI-assistant/knowledge-graph features, but nowhere describes a built-in anomaly or outlier detection capability that replaces hand-written thresholds (e.g., Grafana ML forecasting/outlier detection is not cited). Alerting docs explicitly describe rule-based thresholds and expressions rather than automatic anomaly surfacing.
